headline: STL @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 5.75 at MIN 3.97, with a projected total of 9.72. NRFI probability dropped -7.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Batter research is strongest for Jordan Walker, Alec Burleson, Kody Clemens, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
